checks.explanation: Actual tariff revenue was far below the claimed $500 billion/year baseline: FY2026 net tariff receipts were about $163 billion after Supreme Court-ordered refunds, nowhere near a trillion-dollar trajectory.
No aggregate government report confirming or denying a roughly trillion-dollar-a-year fraud crackdown was found.
Actual Q4 2025 GDP growth came in at 0.5% (revised down from an initial 0.7%), far below the predicted 2.5%.
Actual Q1 2026 GDP growth was 2.0-2.1% (BEA advance/third estimates), far below the predicted 5%.
GDP growth stayed around 2% in Q1 2026 regardless of Fed leadership changes, nowhere near the predicted 6%.
